transformations: Describe filtering, missing values, units, transformations, aggregation, smoothing and random seeds.

design.pairing_blocking_nesting: Specify IDs, blocks, repeated measures, depths and spatial structure.

statistics.estimand: Specify the plotted effect or summary.
statistics.uncertainty: Specify SD, SE, CI, PI, credible interval, posterior or spatial uncertainty.
statistics.model: Specify the verified model object or descriptive calculation.
statistics.multiplicity: Specify correction family or state not applicable.

notes: Record journal-specific decisions, unresolved checks and manual visual-review date.
